steps.goal: Parent mesh to armature with automatic weights

actions.ui_element: Set Parent To > With Automatic Weights

steps.group: Parent mesh to armature with automatic weights
common_mistakes: Selecting the armature first before the mesh will parent the armature to the mesh instead of the reverse.
Selecting the armature before the mesh (wrong order) parents the wrong way round. (official: Blender manual: Armature Deform Parent)
assumptions: Before this: The armature's bones that should move the mesh are set to Deform (Properties > Bone > Deform).
Before this: Mesh in a clean rest pose; apply scale on both the mesh and the armature (see mistakes).
